title: Staking Dashboard
caption: Here you can manage and delegate your {{currency}} to a Stakepool and earn some passive income.
subCaption: Your funds never leave your wallet for staking on Cardano, and you can spend them anytime.

staking-cta.title: Earn staking rewards!
staking-cta.caption: Click the button to pick a stake pool.

poollist.title: Available stake pools
poollist.caption: Here's a list of available stake pools. Enter a pool's ticker or name to filter the list. The ranking prioritizes the best rewards for you.

history.label: Rewards History
history.caption: A list of rewards you've earned from staking and Catalyst voting, sorted by epoch.

nodelegation.info: Please consider delegating to a DRep for governance actions. It'll be required in the next era to be able to withdraw staking rewards.

gov.inactive: Your account is delegated to a governance DRep that's marked as inactive, so it doesn't count towards the active voting stake anymore.

high.headline: High Pool Fee
high.caption: The pool this account is delegated to has an unusually high fee, which will reduce your staking rewards. If it's some kind of ISPO, that's okay. Otherwise, you should choose another pool with lower fees.

complete.headline: 99+% Pool Fee
complete.caption: The pool this account is delegated to charges at least 99% and collects your {{currency}} rewards. If it's some kind of ISPO, that's okay. Otherwise, you should choose another pool with lower fees.
